description: Windsor.ai Google Search Console helps SEOs and marketers explore live Search Console data. Users can discover connected Search Console sites, inspect valid dimensions and metrics, and query organic search performance — clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position by query, page, country, device, and date — over any date range, and connect the Search Console connector. It provides read-only analytics: it does not run write actions, submit or change sitemaps, or modify any Search Console settings. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.

defaultPrompt: How is my site doing in Google Search this month — clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position?
Which search queries drove the most clicks to my site in the last 28 days?
Which pages gained or lost the most clicks this month versus last month?
